author: Ankit
problem: Read a positive integer N (up to 10^18). Print Yes if N = 2^x * 3^y for some non-negative integers x and y, otherwise No.
bug_description: After dividing out all 3s and 2s it checks n == 0 instead of n == 1, so it always prints No.

comments.accurate: Divides out every factor of 3 and 2 and checks that nothing else is left
comments.wrong_behavior: Strips all factors of 3 and 2; only a number that reduces to zero is accepted
comments.wrong_location: Final check verified; check the loop order, since 2s are removed after 3s
